status: Seat arrangement from the Polish Osa-AK manual's cabin plan (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3, pp. 23–25), confirmed by WZU camera views of a Polish crew at work (grezicki_wzu Fig. 4): driver front left, commander front right, the three operators on one bench along the left wall facing the main console SŁ-2M, front to rear guidance (deputy commander), search (senior operator), range (operator). The operator panels are SAM Simulator's photographs of the three columns (samsim_panels), at 1 mm per pixel: every control, lamp and screen sits where it is in those photos, cross-checked against real-cabin photos (cabin_photos) and the game's sprite positions. Distances between seats, the columns' height above the floor and the controls the game has no picture for are SAM3D estimates that only need to be reachable and readable. Lamp meanings follow the SAM Simulator manual where it gives them.
notes: Body frame: metres, x right, y forward, z up, from the ground under the hull centre. The placeholder hull in Unreal is 9.1 x 2.8 m with its roof at 2.2 m. Lamp sources use the source ids of data/procedures/osa_ak.json. Red dots (red_dot) are only given where a picture shows one: they mark a control's working position, not where it starts (docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md §12).

stations.label: Senior operator
stations.notes: Middle seat of the left bench, in front of the search indicator (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3: search operator; grezicki_wzu Fig. 4: OP).

stations.label: Operator
stations.notes: Rear seat of the left bench (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3: range operator; grezicki_wzu Fig. 4: OO, on the rear side of OP).

stations.label: Deputy commander
stations.notes: Front seat of the left bench (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3: the senior, guidance operator; telephone TA-57 here). grezicki_wzu Fig. 4 shows the guidance operator (ON) beside the search operator (OP), on the forward side.

panels.label: SOC / SSC azimuth (senior operator)
panels.notes: Middle column of SŁ-2M, top to bottom (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; cabin_photos): lamp row 0094-9, search indicator OP81-16M with its switches either side of the scope, OP63-6M2, azimuth block OS52-12M with the hand wheel on the right, OK81-4M-I. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel).

panels.label: SSC range (operator)
panels.notes: Rear column of SŁ-2M, top to bottom (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; cabin_photos): meter block 0062-6M, range indicator OS81-9M (small screen, ГОТОВ, ВКЛ. ВЫСОК., ПЕРЕДАТЧИК, РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ / КАЛИБР., ЦЕЛЬ), OK62-5M, OS61-5M (СДЦ / ШТ., wind compensation), range block OS81-18M (АВТОМАТ, ПОЛУАВТОМАТ, ТСЦ, РУЧНОЕ, range window, hand wheel), 0051-7M. The plates are readable in the game photo. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel).

panels.label: SSC elevation / TOV / launch (deputy commander)
panels.notes: Front column of SŁ-2M, top to bottom (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; cabin_photos): meter block 0004-14M (four ε/β meters, not modelled), TV monitor WPU-44 with the round elevation-search indicator OS81-10M to its right (not modelled yet; space left in the photo position), launch block 0004-11M (КАНАЛЫ button groups, numbered ИЗДЕЛИЯ list and selector, РОД РАБОТЫ, the ДЦ meter (labelled ДЦ in the game photo), the guarded АВАРИЙНЫЙ ПУСК), elevation block OS52-14M1 (hand wheel on the right), OK51-6M. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel).

displays.label: SOC indicator
displays.notes: Search picture up to 45 km on the selected scale, with the SSC azimuth line and range gate the operator puts on the target mark (p22). Sweep period, afterglow, the 10-45 km scale drawn as a delayed sweep (centre = 10 km), the clutter disc and the gate marker are SAM3D estimates.

displays.label: Range indicator
displays.notes: Two sweeps: the upper shows 0-28 km with the target as a spike, the lower a 1.5 km magnification around the range gates. The counter shows the range wheel (p24 item 2). Sweeps appear 1 min after switching on, and the radar picture only with РАБОТА selected (voenizdat_osa_1991 p98–100, Fig. 2.36).

displays.label: βс
displays.notes: SSC azimuth in Russian military angle (60-00 = 360 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: TOV monitor
displays.notes: The camera looks along the SSC azimuth and elevation with the wide or narrow lens; crosshair at the centre.

displays.label: εс
displays.notes: SSC elevation in Russian military angle (15-00 = 90 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: ДЦ
displays.notes: Measured target distance, 10 V = 10 km. Reads while the SSC tracks in range (the range wheel follows the target then); rests at 0 otherwise. Full scale 30 V: SAM3D estimate.
